title: GAP Waiver Addenda Claims: Filing, Decision and Benefit
content:
This policy covers GAP Waiver Addenda claims for a total loss or a theft: when a claim may be filed, how it is decided, and how the benefit is credited.

## 1. Filing

- **Addendum status.** A claim is filed only on an addendum whose status is active. The addendum's status is read from the addendum record. A borrower's statement does not establish it.
- **Reporting period.** The claim must be reported no later than the plan's claim notice period after the date of loss. The reporting period is counted in calendar days from the date of loss, and a report on the last day is in time. The date of loss is the date the claim record of this addendum shows for the reported loss.

| Reported on | Result |
|---|---|
| the last day of the claim notice period, counted from the date of loss | in time |
| the day after that last day | not in time |

## 2. Decision

An addendum takes at most one decided claim, and a decision is matched to the claim record it decides. A loss is a total loss as the plan's loss definition states. A theft is decided only after it has stayed unrecovered for the plan's theft waiting period.

The claim is denied for the first of the following reasons, checked in this order. That first reason is the one recorded.

1. **No primary insurance.** The borrower's own physical-damage insurance was not in force on the date of loss. Force-placed coverage does not count.
2. **Outside the coverage term.** The loss date is outside the coverage term.
3. **Contract not active.** The contract's status on the date of loss was not among the plan's eligible statuses.
4. **Excluded use.** The vehicle was in an excluded use.
5. **Late documents.** The complete claim file was not received within the plan's document period after the primary insurer's settlement.

Otherwise the claim is approved within the plan's decision period, counted from receipt of the complete file.

## 3. Benefit on an approved claim

The benefit is never below 0.00 and never above the plan's largest benefit, and it is rounded half-up to the cent. As written, it is built from these clauses:

- **(a)** the benefit is the scheduled balance on the date of loss, which is the contract principal balance had every installment been paid on its original due date (no extension deferrals), plus interest at the contract rate accrued from the last such due date to the date of loss;
- **(b)** less the portion above the plan's covered loan-to-value percent. That portion is the amount by which the amount financed exceeded the covered percent of the vehicle's book value at origination, reduced in the same proportion as the scheduled balance has amortised (scheduled balance at loss divided by amount financed). It is 0.00 when the amount financed is within the limit;
- **(c)** less every excluded amount, with salvage retained by the borrower excluded at the plan's salvage basis;
- **(d)** less the primary insurer's actual cash value, plus the deductible covered;
- **(e)** where the deductible covered is the primary deductible actually deducted, up to the plan's deductible reimbursement maximum.

**Clauses no longer in force:**

| Clause | GAP Waiver Premier 150 claim | GAP Waiver Plus 150 claim | Claim on any other plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) scheduled balance as the starting point | no longer in force; the current Premier starting-balance basis governs | no longer in force; the current Plus starting-balance basis governs | still in force: the scheduled balance with interest accrued to the date of loss |
| (b) portion above the covered loan-to-value | no longer in force; the current Premier worksheet basis governs | no longer in force; the current Plus worksheet basis governs | still in force, amortized in the same proportion as the scheduled balance |
| (c) every excluded amount | no longer in force; the current Premier exclusion basis governs | no longer in force; the current Plus exclusion basis governs | still in force |
| (d) actual cash value less, deductible covered added | no longer in force; the current Premier worksheet basis governs | no longer in force; the current Plus worksheet basis governs | still in force |
| (e) deductible covered basis | no longer in force; the current Premier deductible reimbursement basis governs | still in force | still in force |

The rest of this policy remains in force for every plan, including the 0.00 floor, the largest-benefit cap and the half-up rounding of the benefit.

## 4. After the decision

The benefit is credited to the contract within the plan's payment period after approval. It is never paid to the borrower. Any excluded amounts stay owed by the borrower on the contract. A denied claim ends the addendum as of the date of loss, and its unearned charge is refunded under the cancellation refund rules. A claim withdrawn because the vehicle was repaired returns the addendum to active. A written denial stating the reason is mailed within the plan's denial-notice period.
